name: ai-customer-support-saas
description: Multi-tenant AI customer support & helpdesk SaaS (MERN + TypeScript).

scripts.dev:server:memory: npm run db:memory & sleep 2 && PORT=8000 MONGODB_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27777/ai_support_saas npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
